hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+commit'; then REPO_ROOT=$(git -C "$(pwd)" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); SENTINEL="${REPO_ROOT}/.claude/.cc-active"; if [ ! -f "$SENTINEL" ]; then echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "[가드레일] git commit은 /commit-convention 스킬을 통해서만 실행할 수 있습니다."}'; exit 1; fi; fi
